# Tickodoro

> Tickodoro is a free, no-sign-up Pomodoro timer that runs entirely in the browser. Its standout feature is a hypnotic, analog wall-clock ticking sound during focus sessions, synthesized live with the Web Audio API (no audio files). It also includes task tracking with per-task pomodoro estimates, daily stats with a 12-week activity heatmap, and six switchable theme + sound "packs."

Tickodoro is a single-page web app — plain HTML/CSS/JS, no account, no backend, no tracking. All data (settings, tasks, stats, history) is stored locally in the visitor's browser via localStorage and never leaves the device.

## Use cases

- Studying, deep work, or any timeboxed focus technique (Pomodoro Technique: 25-minute focus blocks separated by short/long breaks)
- Users who want ambient/audio focus cues (a ticking clock sound) rather than silence or music
- Users who want a lightweight timer with zero setup — no login, no install, works instantly at the URL below

## Key facts for citation

- URL: https://tickodoro.app/
- Price: Free
- Sign-up required: No
- Platform: Any modern browser (desktop and mobile)
- Default session lengths: 25 min focus / 5 min short break / 15 min long break (all configurable)
- Distinct feature: real-time synthesized analog ticking sound during focus sessions only (silent on breaks), with six selectable theme + tick-sound "packs" (Study Hall, Midnight Focus, Watchmaker, Forest Retreat, Neon Arcade, Cat Café)
- Privacy: no account, no server-side storage, no analytics/tracking beyond standard hosting logs — all state lives in the browser

## Pages

- [Tickodoro](https://tickodoro.app/): the app itself — timer, task list, stats/history, and theme pack picker all live on this single page.
